id: \rI only got four ribbons. It's not fair!
en: \rI only got four ribbons. It's not fair!
it: \rHo preso solo quattro Fiocchi. Non è giusto!

id: \bMy mom made it in. I'm so proud of her.
en: \bMy mom made it in. I'm so proud of her.
it: \bMia mamma è riuscita a entrare. Sono così fiero di lei.

id: \rI'm very sorry, but you don't have enough ribbons to enter.
en: \rI'm very sorry, but you don't have enough ribbons to enter.
it: \rMi dispiace molto, ma non hai abbastanza Fiocchi per partecipare.

id: \rMay: \PN, did you come to cheer me on? Thank you.
en: \rMay: \PN, did you come to cheer me on? Thank you.
it: \rVera: \PN, sei venuto a fare il tifo per me? Grazie.

id: \rWait, aren't you busy with your Frontier challenge? You should go finish that.
en: \rWait, aren't you busy with your Frontier challenge?  You should go finish that.
it: \rAspetta, non eri impegnato con la tua sfida del Parco Lotta?  Dovresti andare a finirla.

id: \rIf you need an extra Pokémon I saw an Aipom nearby. It should be in the gate.
en: \rIf you need an extra Pokémon I saw an Aipom nearby. It should be in the gate.
it: \rSe ti serve un Pokémon in più, ho visto un Aipom qui vicino. Dovrebbe essere nel varco.

id: \rMay: If you need an extra Pokémon I saw an Aipom nearby. It should be in the gate.
en: \rMay: If you need an extra Pokémon I saw an Aipom nearby. It should be in the gate.
it: \rVera: Se ti serve un Pokémon in più, ho visto un Aipom qui vicino. Dovrebbe essere nel varco.

id: \bSome of the Trainers here are the real deal.
en: \bSome of the Trainers here are the real deal.

id: \rYou're not here to compete, are you?
en: \rYou're not here to compete, are you?

id: \rI aim to win this but I'm sure we'll all remain friends afterwards.
en: \rI aim to win this but I'm sure we'll all remain friends afterwards.
it: \rPunto a vincere, ma sono sicura che resteremo tutti amici anche dopo.

id: \rI'm so glad I got to come.
en: \rI'm so glad I got to come.
it: \rSono così felice di essere potuta venire.

id: \bIs someone interrupting me now? No, I can't allow that.
en: \bIs someone interrupting me now? No, I can't allow that.
it: \bQualcuno mi sta interrompendo? No, non posso permetterlo.

id: \bWhatever. A battle means nothing compared to the Contest.
en: \bWhatever. A battle means nothing compared to the Contest.
it: \bChe importa. Una lotta non è niente in confronto alla Gara.

id: \bI need some last minute practice if I'm going to beat May.
en: \bI need some last minute practice if I'm going to beat May.
it: \bMi serve un po' di pratica dell'ultimo minuto se voglio battere Vera.

id: \bI'll get better. The victory will be mine.
en: \bI'll get better. The victory will be mine.

id: \bShould I try for elegance or raw power?
en: \bShould I try for elegance or raw power?
it: \bDovrei puntare sull'eleganza o sulla forza bruta?
